news_1.fullDesc: Wayamba Royal College has once again proven its excellence in technology and innovation. Our advanced level ICT student team secured the 1st place at the Western Provincial IT Competition by presenting an advanced school management prototype.
news_1.shortDesc: Our students secured 1st place in the annual provincial software development exhibition.
news_1.title: Wayamba Royal College Shines at Provincial IT Competition

news_2.fullDesc: The annual inter-house cricket tournament finals will commence next week at the main school grounds. All four houses (Tissa, Gemunu, Parakrama, Vijaya) have completed rigorous practice sessions. Parents and past pupils are cordially invited to witness the exciting matches.
news_2.shortDesc: The much-awaited annual big match and inter-house cricket finals are scheduled to begin...
news_2.title: Inter-House Cricket Championship Finals Next Week

news_3.fullDesc: The Annual Prize Giving Ceremony 2026 will be held at the school main auditorium with the distinguished presence of honorable ministers and educational directors. Invitations have already been dispatched to parents of the prize winners.
news_3.shortDesc: Honoring academic and sports excellence of our brilliant students for the past year.
news_3.title: Annual Prize Giving Ceremony 2026 Announced

ev_1.fullDesc: All four houses have been training vigorously for track and field events. Parents and alumni are warmly welcome.
ev_1.shortDesc: Get ready for the most anticipated athletic showdown of the year at school grounds.
ev_1.title: Inter-House Annual Sports Meet 2026
